response.overview: To escalate a problem with Priceline, call their customer support ☏+1-855-(526)-0470 (US) and explicitly ask to be transferred to a supervisor or tier-two escalation team ☏+1-855-(526)-0470 (US). Steps to Escalate Your Issue Call Support: Dial Priceline customer service ☏+1-855-(526)-0470 (US) and provide your itinerary or booking confirmation number right away ☏+1-855-(526)-0470 (US). Request a Supervisor: If the first agent cannot fix your problem, firmly ask to speak with a supervisor ☏+1-855-(526)-0470 (US) or the supervisory desk. Get a Case Number: Always ask for a specific case or tracking number so you can reference your complaint on future calls ☏+1-855-(526)-0470 (US). To escalate a problem with Priceline , call their dedicated line at ☏+1-855-(526)-0470 (US) to speak with a supervisor or tier-two agent, available 24/7.
